title: senna cushina
intro: Senna cushina, commonly known as the bush senna, is a flowering plant species belonging to the legume family. The health benefits of Senna cushina include its use as a natural laxative, helping to relieve constipation and promote digestive regularity. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Senna cushina include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential benefits in traditional medicine.
